data.summary: Experienced Full Stack Developer with a strong background in Python development using Flask and Django, and extensive expertise in modern JavaScript technologies such as Node.js, NestJS, Next.js, React, React Native, Express.js, and MongoDB for building dynamic, scalable web and mobile applications. Highly proﬁcient in React for developing responsive and intuitive front-end interfaces. Skilled in data analysis and visualization with Pandas and Matplotlib, and experienced in automation using Selenium. Adept at web scraping, developing desktop applications with PyQt5, and building both RESTful and GraphQL APIs. Strong foundation in database management using SQL and PostgreSQL. Experienced with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Hands-on knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Nginx for containerization, orchestration, and server conﬁguration. Proﬁcient in version control with Git, and skilled in front-end technologies including JavaScript, jQuery, CSS3, and HTML5. A collaborative team player and problem-solver, passionate about delivering high-performance, maintainable, and production-ready solutions.

responsibilities: Developed and maintained scalable web applications, resulting in a 30% improvement in performance.

Developed and maintained scalable, high-performance web applications using Node.js for backend services and Next.js for frontend interfaces, ensuring seamless integration and a smooth user experience across the full stack.
Designed and implemented RESTful and GraphQL APIs using NestJS, enabling efﬁcient and secure communication between client-side applications and backend services.
Utilized server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG) with Next.js to improve page load times, SEO, and overall application performance.
Deployed and managed applications on cloud platforms like AWS or DigitalOcean, setting up CI/CD pipelines and ensuring reliable, automated delivery of updates and new features.

Designed and developed a scalable, enterprise-level web scraping system tailored for Indian e-commerce platforms, enabling automated extraction of pricing, availability, and product metadata across thousands of listings.
Engineered robust scraping pipelines using Python, BeautifulSoup, lxml, and Selenium, handling anti-bot mechanisms, dynamic content, and CAPTCHAs.
Implemented proxy rotation, user-agent spooﬁng, and throttling strategies to ensure long-term scraper reliability and IP protection.
Integrated scraped data with MongoDB and PostgreSQL, supporting real-time analytics and competitive pricing dashboards.
Automated scheduled scraping jobs using cron and Celery, processing millions of records daily with minimal downtime.
Developed and maintained scalable web applications using Django on the backend and React on the frontend, enabling seamless integration of RESTful APIs with dynamic user interfaces.
Designed and implemented reusable, responsive UI components using React, optimizing performance and accessibility across modern browsers and devices.
Built robust backends with Django REST Framework, handling complex business logic, secure user authentication, and third-party service integrations.
Led full-stack development for internal tools and client projects, leveraging Django, React, and PostgreSQL, signiﬁcantly reducing development turnaround time.
Integrated MongoDB and SQL/PostgreSQL databases across microservices and monolithic systems, ensuring optimal data consistency and scalability.
Web Development: Built responsive and dynamic websites using Django, React, and other modern frameworks.
Web Scraping: Developed efﬁcient web scraping scripts and solutions using Python libraries like BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, and Selenium.
Desktop Application Development: Created robust desktop applications tailored to client needs.
Data Science and Data Analysis: Applied data science techniques and tools for insightful data analysis and visualization.
Automation: Implemented automation solutions to streamline workﬂows and increase efﬁciency.
Achieved a 90%+ client retention rate through consistent delivery of high-quality work and excellent customer service.
